sloka: तथा तु तौ संयति सम्प्रयुक्तौ तरस्विनौ वानरराक्षसानाम्।बलार्णवौ सस्वनतुः सुभीमं महार्णवौ द्वाविव भिन्नवेलौ ।। ६.९७.३५ ।।
transliteration: tathā tu tau saṁyati samprayuktau tarasvinau vānararākṣasānām।balārṇavau sasvanatuḥ subhīmaṁ mahārṇavau dvāviva bhinnavelau ।। 6.97.35 ।।

translations.english: Thus, both close to each other, both redoubtable armies, of Vanaras and Rakshasas, both powerful and terrific, both mighty, roared as if the great ocean had burst.
